why_choose_us.title: Four state licenses, one company
why_choose_us.description: General contracting (CGC1520370), roofing (CCC1329807), air conditioning (CAC1817062) and plumbing (CFC1429344) are all held in-house. Most GCs sub all four out.

why_choose_us.title: Building in South Florida since 2012
why_choose_us.description: Fourteen years of Miami-Dade permitting, inspections and High-Velocity Hurricane Zone code — on residential and commercial work alike.

why_choose_us.title: The scope is written down first
why_choose_us.description: You get a written scope and a realistic permit timeline before anything starts. If a job needs a trade we don't self-perform, we say so up front instead of at rough-in.

why_choose_us.title: One contract, one point of contact
why_choose_us.description: A re-roof that also needs new impact windows and an AC changeout is one schedule and one invoice — not three companies blaming each other.

closing_cta.body: GARP Construction Group has been a licensed South Florida general contractor since 2012, working on residential and commercial projects across Miami-Dade. Estimates are free, and we will tell you honestly whether a repair or a replacement is the right call.
